hero.eyebrow: Integrated Services Brief for Highmark Health
hero.title: Highmark Public Site and Shop Migration to Edge Delivery Services
hero.body: Move highmark.com and the shop.highmark.com plan-shopping flow onto Edge Delivery Services with one shared set of standard blocks. The work covers the highmark.com migration, a native rebuild of the shop flow, regional branding by zip code and county, and on-site search. Delivered in three workstreams: Migrate, Shop Flow Rebuild, and Regional Branding and Search.

problem.heading: Highmark's public sites rely on one-off components and two separate stacks, which slows every change
problem.lead: highmark.com is built from highly custom components, and the plan-shopping flow on shop.highmark.com runs on a separate Angular and Redux implementation. Each page change takes manual effort, and the two experiences do not share a look or behavior. Until the sites run on one standard platform, change stays slow and the personalization roadmap stays blocked.

points.title: Components are one-off
points.body: Current components are custom to individual pages, so standardizing and changing them takes more effort than it should.

points.title: Two stacks, two experiences
points.body: The plan-shopping flow is built separately from highmark.com, so the two sites do not look or behave consistently.

points.title: Regional logic is hard to maintain
points.body: Brand, plan cards, and plan documents depend on zip code and county logic that must be rebuilt before it can be governed on the new platform.

overview.heading: What this program delivers
overview.lead: The public front door and the plan-shopping flow move to Edge Delivery Services on a shared set of standard blocks. highmark.com is migrated, shop.highmark.com is rebuilt natively on Edge, and the zip code and county branding and on-site search are carried over. Each workstream is its own activation and runs between 4 and 12 weeks.

stats.label: Weeks end to end
stats.sub: Migration, shop rebuild, and regional branding run back to back.

types.heading: How the work is classified
types.lead: Activations are rapid, 4 to 12 week, hands-on engagements led by Adobe experts to activate specific use cases. Each activation is delivered one at a time for focused execution and measurable impact. These are the activation types we assume will deliver best for this work, and we look to Adobe to confirm the best fit.

workstreams.name: Migrate
objective: Migrate highmark.com to Edge Delivery Services and replace one-off custom components with standard blocks.
Establish the header, hero, and card blocks that the shop flow will reuse.

acts.name: Migration Readiness and Content Inventory
acts.desc: Confirm the highmark.com page inventory across plans, employer, member, and regional-brand sections, and set the migration order. Map current custom components to standard blocks.

acts.name: Bulk Page Migration
acts.desc: Migrate highmark.com pages to Edge Delivery Services using the Experience Modernization Agent, then review and correct the output page by page.

acts.name: Standardize Header, Hero, and Card Blocks
acts.desc: Build the standard header, hero, and card blocks used across highmark.com and shop.highmark.com, and apply them to the migrated pages.
del: Standard header, hero, and card blocks

workstreams.name: Shop Flow Rebuild
objective: Rebuild the shop.highmark.com plan-shopping flow natively on Edge Delivery Services in place of the Angular and Redux implementation.
Reuse the highmark.com blocks so both sites look and behave consistently.

acts.name: Requirements and Architecture
acts.desc: Document the plan-shopping flow requirements and define how each step maps to Edge Delivery Services components and the shared blocks.

acts.name: Build Native Shop Flow on Edge
acts.desc: Build the plan-shopping flow natively on Edge Delivery Services, reusing the standard blocks from the Migrate workstream.

acts.name: Flow Testing and Cutover Readiness
acts.desc: Test the full plan-shopping flow end to end, then prepare cutover and the handoff to the Highmark team.

workstreams.name: Regional Branding and Search
objective: Rebuild zip code and county regional branding as an Edge-native component that drives brand, plan cards, and plan documents.
Replicate on-site search on the Edge build.

acts.name: Zip and County Branding Component
acts.desc: Rebuild the zip code and county regional branding and plan-document logic as an Edge-native component. Starts once Highmark supplies the full zip and county list.
del: Plan card and plan document routing rules

acts.name: On-Site Search Replication
acts.desc: Replicate highmark.com's on-site search on the Edge build, building on the pages already indexed in the first pass.
del: Working on-site search on the Edge build

acts.name: Regional and Search Testing
acts.desc: Test regional branding and search across zip codes, counties, and migrated pages before handoff.
